content_gaps: Ranking pages are mostly custodian or vendor pages written for institutions.
Consumer pages compare products but skip insolvency and counterparty risk.
Few pages reviewed reflect the October 2026 SEC proposal.
The practical difference between holding keys and holding a claim on a custodian is rarely spelled out.
value_add: A neutral comparison of custody models by who holds the keys and what fails in each, with the current US regulatory position sourced to the regulators.

claims.statement: In May 2025 the OCC confirmed that national banks may provide and outsource crypto custody and execution services.
On October 1, 2026 the SEC proposed rules that would permit self-custody in certain circumstances and the use of state trust companies.
The SEC lists the custody proposal on its Crypto@SEC page.
